Pictographic · Independent visual audit · 15 September 2026

Rejected solo icons
Batch 01 · Icons 1–50

Reviewed in the rejected gallery’s displayed order, from acro-yoga-folded-balance through bikini. Every drawing was inspected enlarged, as centerlines, and at native 48px in light and dark themes, with its linked original where available.

3Good drawings
47Not good under this review
50 / 50Fresh build passes

A build pass does not establish drawing quality. “Good” means the current drawing is visually convincing and passes the selected icon checks. This audit does not change the gallery’s rejected status or redraw any icon.

Standards: icon-solo, authoring, validation, reference triage and shared human construction. Portrait busts need the icon-avatar specialization within solo; arrows/operators need icon-sub. The current shared human guide uses touching ink for portrait heads and bodies, and exactly 4u ink clearance for detached stick figures. The old user.svg is a proportion reference and does not override that current avatar rule.

Construction comparisons inspected: local Lucide aperture and bug, including atomic-debug views; shared human user.svg and full_body_ref.png. Other subjects were compared with their supplied originals and the geometric checklist. No drawing was authored in this audit.

The selected 50-icon build passed with zero warnings and identical reviewed SVGs. Library-wide tests: 406 run, 7 failures, 30 sandbox server errors and 1 skip. All 30 server tests passed when rerun with localhost access. Seven library/fixture failures remain; this is not a claim that the whole library passes.
